text:
Well, during our recent visit to Paris we dined at this place, it was on 25th of Dec, there were a lot of people and the staff were really stressed and impatient. We faced multiple issues, we had ordered Large fries, the fries provided were broken (pic) and were poorly cooked. Instead of Cappuccino, we had been given Espresso (pic), ofcourse the exchange was provided without any excuse. And the level of stench that was emanating from the toilet was unbearable. Certainly the worst experience we had with the McD till date and that too on one of the most well known streets. Being a vegetarian, found '0' options for veg burger also.
This experience sealed it for me, no more McDs!

Additional text (added on 2nd Jan 23), called to the contact provided of the store, not sure if the person understood what I spoke, got the call cut. The better I can do is to drop an email as there are language constraints. Let me know.
author: Vishwas Nagaraju

text:
Food quality: below criticism (photo attached).
Humanity: zero.

There was strong, cold wind blowing, so our group of 8 people + 1 dog wanted to step inside. Since there was no pictogram and no written sign stating that dogs are not allowed, we entered with my shivering dog — only into the entrance area — so we wouldn’t disturb anyone while the rest of the family was ordering.

After half a minute, the security guard forced us out. I repeatedly pointed out that there was no sign prohibiting dogs. Despite this, he became louder and louder, shouting “OUT!”

We then sat outside in the freezing cold and waited for the others.

Later, I received something that could barely be called food.

The only positive thing was that the hot chocolate was perfectly made and the barista was very nice.

I honestly hope the place goes bankrupt and gets replaced by an O’tacos or another more decent food chain.
author: Zsolt Kiss

text:
I actually love Mcdonald’s but this is the worst I have ever been. Self service down, dirty on every inch. They check you at entrance like a terrorist. Burned, dry, tasteless burgers with old cold fries. The only thing I was expecting from this place was a simple cheeseburger with some crispy fries, the same flavor I have tasted on every other Mcdonalds in Europe, but nope, not even that.

They charge you .50 euro cents for nasty bathrooms with no separation for men and women so you might see some guy waving his penis as he finishes peeing. No hand soap. I only had 5 .10 coins so I asked the cashier for a .50 but she told me she had none so as a customer my options were just to pee myself there or wait for some other customers to help me.

I hated this place. This place damages Mcdonalds brand.
author: Denisse Miranda

text: This was the worst experience at a McDonald’s we’ve ever had. They messed up order and then tried to blame us for them giving us someone else’s order but the correct drink order. Chicken nuggets are not a hamburger and fish sandwiches aren’t cheeseburgers plus cold fries. They took our receipt and then once we sat down we realized they didn’t give us cheese fries. So we went back up and they wanted to argue again. Since we didn’t have receipt that they took we couldn’t prove and apparently they are unable to look up the order that we memorized the code since we had to go up there so many times. Maybe this is the French way but I’m confident it’s not McDonalds Corp a trusted American brand.  Managers were even rude we attempted to talk to them politely.
author: Scouts BSA

text: The token system for the bathroom is the dumbest system I have ever seen and an embarrassment for the international McDonalds brand. I asked the lady behind the counter for a token, as it says on the receipt, for her to tell me to present my receipt in the bathroom. Present it to who? There was no one posted in the men’s for the entire time I was at the McDonalds. I checked a few times over the 45 minutes I was there. My partner got a token from a lady working in the women’s bathroom for me to use. Then there is the more concerning issue that someone else with a token can open the toilet stall door when you are in there, which happened to me. Get rid of the stupid system and just have someone clean the toilets more often if that’s the issue.
author: James Middleton

text:
Very poor practice, maybe discriminatory. Women have to pay to use the toilet or show a receipt, men just walk straight in. Why is it different for men and women? Shouldn't it be the same?
I do not agree with the reply from the owner. On the day we visited, men and women were being treated differently. Only access to the ladies toilets was restricted. A member of staff was only asking for proof of purchase from women. Men just simply skipped the queue and walked straight in the gents toilets, no token or showing a receipt needed for men.
Visited in June 2025 and exactly the same thing again.  Only women being asked,  men just walk straight in the toilets.

Food was really good from the McCafe.
author: Ian

text:
Visited the McDonald's on the Champs-Élysées and it was honestly a terrible experience. We waited 45 minutes just to order at the self-service display – completely disorganized. Even though there were free tables, there were no table numbers available, which made things even more frustrating.

The food quality has really gone downhill. I know it's fast food and expectations should be realistic, but the gap between the photos and what you actually get is almost laughable.

I only went because of my kids, but honestly, there are other fast-food chains doing a much better job these days – both in quality and service.
author: Ben Krettels

text: Yeah, that was the worst McDonalds I ever had. The staff is so slow, I never ever saw it it any country. My food was for 10 minutes on the counter and nothing, till I told the girl, if she would be so nice to give it over to me, because it was already ready to go. So thanks to this laziness and extrem slowness, it was cold and tasteless. But no worry, they will give you three free ketchup or mayo sauces to every order, but sorry, I dont need anything for free, just work faster and try to look a lil bit less annoyed.
author: andy weik

text: Went in to use the bathroom; waited 30 minutes. The place is hot and gross and the service was terrible. Within the 30 minutes, we ordered a single Fanta… didn’t come until 30-40 minutes. Upon receiving the drink. The (plastic) cup was soggy and squishy. The 15ish year old boy at the front counter wouldn’t listen or get us our drink, choosing to ignore our very simple request. He seemed very lost. Might wanna put him back through training 🫶 Along with the price - 3.5€ for MEDIUM soda.
author: Kadence

text: Wow! This place looks amazing and it's a familiar site for most tourists. The service was absolutely terrible. We waited 30 minutes for fries and a drink just as a quick refresher before we hit the Arc and we totally regretted stopping there versus somewhere else. Nobody would listen to the fact that we hadn't gotten our order and they dismissed us as tourists like they could just write us off. If you're looking for a spot familiar to what you're used to this probably isn't it.
author: Robert Barnes

text:
RUDEST STAFF EVER. AVOID.
I had food and threw away the receipt, I never keep them, then I needed to use the toilet.
The horribly unpleasant woman demanded the receipt or cash, otherwise you cannot go to the bathroom, she's basically denying a basic human right to a person who eats in the place and pays plenty of money.
I hope they fire that horrendous person and take customer service seriously.
author: María Jimena Martinez

text: Food is just average, the place is small and over crowded and badly managed. Tables and chairs are dirty. The security is rude and disrespectful. They try and manage instead of making sure the place is safe. The security shout at their customers which is not the best customer service. This place is overhyped and the security needs to fix their stinking attitude. Customer service is a -5
author: Sheena D

text:
Worst McDonald’s ever.
They forgot to put sauces and no straws.
I get it “ecology” but when my friend came back to ask for straws he said: “sorry do you…” and right away was angrily rejected..

When I came down they said they don’t serve straws anymore, ecology! And on my request for mayo and ketchup she slammed 10-15 ketchups on the desk…. Where did ecology go???
Disgusting
author: Bohdan Baran

text: rude employees. I was at this Mc Donalds on 03/24/2024 and the security guard kicked me out of the store, I was with my boyfriend. We ordered snacks to eat on site, but the security guard wanted to kick us out of the store because it was close to closing time. Worst McDonalds I've ever been to in the world! There is no standard of service from Mc Donalds! close this store!
author: Fabio Rodrigues

text:
The taste was not up to McDonald's Standard the Big Mac was served cold a little bit and very little sauce and one cheese slice.
The drink was without ice but cold.
The toilets were very dirty and smelly.
One of the staff was insisting on talking French to the tourists and calling the orders in French numbers. while they couldn't understand her and  everyone was confused.
author: sami masry sy

text:
If you order coffee from the computer you should 'know' to go to the McCafe are not where everyone else is queueing to collect their food AND drinks. Then when you complain expect to be told all of the above. If you then ask for your drink to be redone expect a fat no!
Toilets are also €1 coin, no card.
All in all the worst experience in a 5 day stop in Paris.
author: Dee Jay

text:
Food was OK but long wait.
My wife and daughter spent 15 minutes in the queue for the toilet to be told when they got to the front they couldn't use it as we had put the food receipt in the bin after eating. 50 euro on food and not allowed to use a toilet. Why are the French so protective of their toilets.
author: OLIVER FLANAGAN

text:
French fries cold, soggy and no salt.
We travelled from Eiffel Tower to George V, just to dine at McDonald's. But disappointed. In Singapore, our McDonald's serve hot fries. Even in London, we have good experience.  The view here is nice and pleasant atmosphere as always. Please take care of fries.
author: Nita Hindocha

text: Cold fries, burgers so small I wanted to cry, every single bite was a regret for spending 20€ on this trash, I haven't ate McDonald's for 3 years straight and now I remember why, just go eat burgers made in your house, it's way cheaper, bigger and better, or might aswell eat at KFC.
author: Xiwang Wei'ling

text: This place was horrible. You order at a kiosk and pay there, you get a number, and a server brings you your food. Great. The guy gives my food to another table, so they ate for free. I'm here waiting for my meal almost 30 minutes. Nothing exciting or tasty.
author: Nadya Rodriguez

text: Wifi broken, toilets are shitholes. They still ask for 50cents for the usage. Burgers been old. Long wait time, even though there have been no customers. If this the flagship for McDonalds it is a complete failure. Very bad managed franchise.
author: Andreas Otte

text: I don't want to be rude but wow, look at the pictures. You must really hate your job to prepare such appalling food! And I have learnt the hard way that whenever or wherever you go to McDonald's the food is absolutely rubbish.
author: Meianoite

text: Fries were stale,old and not hot. The bathroom was not clean, no toilet paper, no tissue paper to dry hands and the hand drier did not work. Overall very dirty. And you had the privilege of paying to use the bathroom!!
author: KelleyAnn

text: Should be -5 Stars. Disgusting, tastless Fries. We found in one of the country potatoes a bone inside. Do not recommend to visit this one. Is much more expensive then any other McD in Paris and worse then any other.
author: crazy chris

text: The male staff member was rude and refused to let us eat in the restaurant. He asked the security guard to kick us out of the restaurant. He even beat us at the door and damaged our belongings.
author: Maria G

text: Can not enter with my small dog, not even in my arms to take away food. Last burger (big arch ) I took was disgusting anyway. Macdo used to be somewhat good, familial and cheap.

text: I was forced to buy something just because I had to go to the washroom. My wife was asked proof of purchase before using female washroom. There was no checking on make washroom

text: Extremely slow, menu tricks you on size of coffee, hair in my coke, and the "fresh" orange juice is not squeezed, It comes in a plastic bottle. About 200 ppl inside and noisy.

text: Ordered fries with curry sauce. Paid extra for the curry sauce. Received no curry sauce… 2 items and they still managed to mess it up… so very disappointing. Weren’t even busy
author: Phoebe

text: Hire more ppl for McCafe during weekends pls. I saw my drink was ready 10 mins ago but nobody handed over to me until I asked twice. Took me 20 mins to get a single drink.

text: Worst McDonalds I have ever eaten!! Cold fries, stale burgers.... very poor! 50 euro I should have thrown into the street. Go eat anywhere else you will thank me for it!!

text: Would appreciate if the special 10 extra ketchup packets I paid for would appear in my order, or at least any amount of ketchup packages would appear in the order.

You can check with the manager and the lady responsible for the restroom on August 25th around 4pm.
